text:
Maya L: Heads-up: were launching a benchmark + webinar the week after next. Need a quick competitive sprint to sharpen SDR one-liners and SE demo hooks. Can we own a 1-hour workblock today?
Jules P: Yes. Scope: cloud provider managed endpoints, LLM API vendors, and inference runtime suppliers. Prioritize the two pain points we keep hearing: unpredictable p95 and surprise token costs.
Rohan S: Ill pull recent win/loss notes into a counterclaim matrix (link: drive/marketing/comp-matrix). Columns: opponent, typical pitch, customer objection, one-line rebuttal, supporting asset.
Avery K: SDRs need 3x snack openers and one micro-case each. Keep them ~3040 chars. Think: "Reserved throughput, not burst only" or "See token-level cost breakdowns".
Samir: Procurement angles: SLA, residency, and who owns optimizations (tuning/quant). Add short legal-safe language we can hand to sales ops.
Jules P: Draft rebuttals (tech-leaning / value-leaning):
- Tech: "Reserved GPU pools + autoscale = steady p95, not spikes."
- Value: "Predictable latency and costs so product features don't regress."
- Customer trust: "Private deployment option keeps data on your network."
Maya L: Good. Now create parallel variants: one for SDR outreach, one for SEs/solutions. SDRs shorter; SEs can mention KV-cache, quantization, and fallback routing.
Rohan S: For the webinar subject A/B: A: "Cut inference cost 23x (real cases)" B: "Demo: p95 under control at 10k qps". We can A/B to top 250 prospects.
Avery K: Ill run 2 SDRs through the scripts in a 10-min mock. Need 12 openers and 6 micro-cases by EOD Tue.
Samir: I'll assemble a 1-page procurement FAQ: SLA bullets, compliance callouts, and a pricing signal (anonymized ranges).
benchbot: Bench upload: /bench/2026/p95-cost-vs-managed-endpoints-2026-03-22.pdf (summary note: typical cost advantage 1.82.7x on sustained p95 workloads).
Jules P: Add a 1-slide quick demo for SEs: 3 copy-paste prompts to show autoscaling fallback, KV cache hit, and live cost telemetry. Keep it under 60s per demo.
Maya L: Action list:
- Maya: write 12 SDR openers + 6 micro-case blurbs (due Tue EOD)
- Jules: populate counterclaim matrix with tech/value variants (Wed noon)
- Rohan: create two slide variants for webinar subject A/B and a 1-slide cost/latency comparison (Mon)
- Samir: procurement FAQ + price ranges (Fri)
Avery K: Ill schedule the SDR playtest Wed 9:15 and post notes.
Maya L: If anyone gets a weird objection that doesnt fit the matrix, drop it here and well slot it. Also thinking we should have 1 privacy-forward line for regulated buyers: "Bring NSS key management + VPC control".
Jules P: Adding that. Also, SE cheat: paste for showing quantization tradeoff: `model.variant(quant=8bit).latency()` and note expected token-cost delta.
Maya L: Great work. Well reconvene after the playtest and lock the battlecard edits. :rocket:
